svg.text: Period T=16000 counts, Master repetition=7 (IRQ every 8*T), Master CMP3=8000, Timer B reset is shifted by +0.5T, CMP2=7872.
Dead time included: RisingValue=60, FallingValue=60, fHRCK=fHRTIM*32, fDTG=fHRTIM*8 => DT=240 PWM counts, about 52 ns at fHRTIM=144 MHz.
Output waveforms are actual complementary pins: high-side rise is delayed by DT; low-side rise after CMP3 is delayed by DT.
CMP1=6400, CMP2=7872, CMP3=9600; DT=240 timer counts
Yellow blocks are both-off dead-time windows. Event rows use short pulses/diamonds instead of full-height spikes.
CMP1=4000, CMP2=7872, CMP3=12000; DT=240 timer counts
Yellow blocks are both-off dead-time windows. Event rows use short pulses/diamonds instead of full-height spikes.
CMP1=1600, CMP2=7872, CMP3=14400; DT=240 timer counts
Yellow blocks are both-off dead-time windows. Event rows use short pulses/diamonds instead of full-height spikes.
